posts.name: Anubis
posts.cooked:
Hey I really enjoy the simplicity of this system it's a fabulous system but I got a bunch of questions (I'm hyper when I'm excited) 

 

1: I talked to Chris at Origins and he said Prime Wardens will be a supplement. As vaguely as you wanna get how much info is in a supplement like Prime Wardens? Five heroes, a supervillain they've fought and maybe an environment? 

 

2: Using Character Creation rules can I be a Tokusatsu hero? I mean more Kamen Rider where my 'forms' are the entire character, not a hero who has forms and fights but say a hero who has several forms and most of their abilities are from transforming. Unlike Meurto and Bunker who can change forms but can do stuff besides that my character concept can't fight without transforming. I was thinking maybe like 2 abilities per zone that my hero always has access to and then like 3 different forms and say 3 on two of them and 2 on third and I don't need to be in a particular GYRO to use any. Can I have that? More flashy transformations over utility? 

 

3: Can we expect to see Holiday themed one shots? A Halloween one fighting like a Scarecrow parody be pretty awesome.

posts.name: bluedarky
posts.cooked: I can’t answer the second, but for the first a supplement is likely to contain a mixture of pre built characters, addtional character creation options (Prime Wardens has been hinted to have Void specific magic stuff and host stuff), villains, canon locations and plot elements, and sample adventures, (Not all supplements may contain all this stuff)

posts.name: XtremeGuardian
posts.cooked:
I can help a little here:

1) We have heard of multiple supplements in the works. Currently it sounds like a mix of villains, pre-made characters, locations, and possibly story arcs. I would also believe that there would be additional and new character creation options.

2) I will say yes? I am not completely familiar with the character but if you look to Bunker, you can see that he can move between different forms (Tyler Vance on foot, Recharge Mode, full Assault mode, etc.). Using that as a basis, it would seem that there would be the possibility to do so and that transformations would be tied to health zone. (I can now see how a Power Ranger mod could be possible where you play as teens in the green zone who would only morph once health or scene tracker hit the yellow zone, maybe zord summoning in the red zone...but I digress)

3) Maybe? For one, I can see the community really supporting this. C&A have also been putting out several cool one shots over the last 14 months or so involving Daybreak. I can see that continuing.
